title: Standalone ordinary prepared C1/C2/C3 receipt
$comment: Ordinary-prepared scope only; exact and prepared-combination admission require their later selected extension. Integer and bit constraints (U, I32, Bits, NonnegativeBits, Hash and their x-rp-encoding) are G2 encoding checks, not G1 shape (C3:301; RV78-N4). The type domain may exceed the emitted domain; G5 enforces the emitted one (RV78-N8). D9b: an unavailable case carries source_ref null|U; source_decline only with null.

summary_coverage.$comment: I57 section 1: null means no complete proof-owned coverage vector was retained; otherwise one closed entry per native body in ascending body id 0..body_count-1; stop order is translation, rotation, force, moment.
